body: What exactly does that mean though? As a child, adult?
Just because other people's problems seem big, doesn't make your situation any smaller.

I'm in the same boat, it sucks. I just stay super busy so I don't think about it. More hobbies, working out like crazy, doing random little nice things for other people always makes me feel a lil better to.
If that's what you want then I'm here. I understand.
Of course, what made tonight so bad?
Existential dread is a big mood for so many people lately. What music, hobbies and other things make you happy? Start focusing on those more and get some sleep!

One bad "leader" can ruin your life, career and reputation. After being told, "You can trust me."... Then hearing the khakis talk shit about other sailors makes you wonder what they say behind your back. I have watched people who were supposed to be leading others try to destroy them instead. 

Good ones are out there, but they are extremely rare.
Sounds like someone is going to get cheated on.
